preconditions.description: The number of sanctums, N, is between 1 and 30000, inclusive.
The number of bridges, M, is between 1 and 30000, inclusive.
Each connection between sanctums is represented by a pair of integers u and v, where 1 <= u, v <= N.

postconditions.description: The output is an integer representing the number of sanctums that, when destroyed, will disconnect the sanctums.
